val_annotation_prescreen.rule: Sort complete paired sequence directories lexicographically; scan exist==1, valid xywh box, w<=12 and h<=12; require at least 160 consecutive frames; order candidates by sequence name then start index. No model output used.
val_annotation_prescreen.fallback_rule: Because no <=12x12 160-frame run exists, rank each sequence earliest 160-frame all-visible window having minimal maximum box side, then rank by this bound, sequence name, start index. This is exploratory alternative, not compliance with <=12x12.

interpretation_limits: VT subset is real 11x11-box ship footage, not evidence about 1-3 pixel aerial targets.
The target has near-fixed annotated image coordinates but no stop/restart event or world-stationary status is established.
Extra VT development sequences absent from DeepPro manifests can still share source scenes; not an independently proven holdout.
VT COCO rectangle segmentation fields must not be presented as true dense pixel masks.
Original Anti-UAV val still useful as engineering cross-dataset diagnostic; not DeepPro benchmark reproduction.
Native NUDT subset is explicitly synthetic and from official test only for loader/evaluation engineering.
